> 第一章 地底世界（第1页）
黑暗笼罩着世界，而人类却手握光明。
寂静空旷的地下山谷中忽然传来一道道低沉恐怖的咆哮之声！
这声音如同雷鸣，在未知黑暗中令人不寒而栗，它不断冲击着湖边黑袍少年的鼓膜，少年捂着耳朵，面露痛苦之色。
黑色的兜帽掉在地上，显露出一张充满贵族气质的英俊面庞，虽然面色煞白，耳朵流血，但眼神却十分的清澈，表情也再次坚毅起来。
此时，地下湖穹顶的岩石如雪崩一样成片的掉落，不断砸在塞恩身旁，而他只能狼狈躲避。
震耳欲聋的声音再一次传来，仿佛在无情嘲笑着这个人类在绝对力量面前的无限渺小，所有的挣扎和反抗都是徒劳。
恐怖咆哮声的主人，是只中级魔兽，咸水巨鳄。
塞恩脚下的地下湖，便是它的栖息地。
眼下，它停止了咆哮，凝视着这个人类，巨大的尾巴抽打着岩石，恐怖的气息让得到喘息之机的塞恩毛骨悚然！
泛白的眼珠在灰暗中散发着幽光，头部大半都有些被火灼烧的痕迹，显然塞恩之前的魔法也对它造成了些许的伤害。
不过在它看来，这个人类显然是在激怒和挑衅自己。
而死亡的恐惧没有完全击倒这个黑魔法学徒，巨鳄的耐心却已经被彻底耗光了！
它猛冲到塞恩身边，张开血盆大口直接咬向塞恩的头颅，尖锐的獠牙上滴淌着涎水，腥臭味令人作呕。
右手指尖用所剩不多的魔力释放出积蓄已久的魔法——
瞬间，一个足球大小的火球飞速而出！
粉末瞬间引起爆燃，加上火球的轰击，瞬间爆开！
震耳欲聋的爆炸声令整个山谷地洞山摇，巨鳄那巨大的前颌被炸的四分五裂，血肉散落一地。
塞恩被这股冲击力震出了三四米远，他堪堪起身，看着面前的巨鳄尸体，兴奋的挥了挥拳头。

粉末，这颗被塞恩寄予厚望的次级火球，爆发出了超乎想象的威力。
战斗结束，由于精神力的过度消耗，魔力也几乎油尽灯枯，塞恩此时的脸色变得惨白无比。
稍微恢复了一丝力气，他先是硬撑着身体站起来，游到湖中间的小岛上摘走了的三株鲜艳星光草，又返回刚才的战场，取走咸水巨鳄最为珍贵的魔晶，以及一块氤氲着不菲元素之力的巨鳄头骨，然后迅速离了湖边。
其实关于中级魔兽咸水巨鳄的价值，塞恩充其量只拿走了一半。
更多的尸体材料和具备充沛魔力元素的魔兽血液被留在了原地，不是他不想拿，而是在这片地下世界，每分每秒都伴随着危险。
已经强弩之末的塞恩此时再无战力，决不能再度置身于危险之中。
三株星光草是他勇闯咸水巨鳄领地的最终目的，是他此次冒着生命危险越级战斗的根本原因。
“呼，呼。”低沉的呼吸声，自黑暗中传来。

> Chapter 1 Underground World (Page 1)
Darkness covers the world, but humans hold the light in their hands.
Suddenly, deep and terrifying roaring sounds came from the silent and empty underground valley!
This sound was like thunder, making people shudder in the unknown darkness. It kept hitting the eardrum of the young man in black robe by the lake. The young man covered his ears with a look of pain on his face.
The black hood fell to the ground, revealing a handsome face full of aristocratic temperament. Although his face was pale and his ears were bleeding, his eyes were very clear and his expression became determined again.
At this time, the rocks on the underground lake dome fell in pieces like an avalanche, constantly hitting Thain, and he could only avoid it in panic.
The deafening sound came again, as if mercilessly mocking the infinite insignificance of this human being in the face of absolute power. All struggles and resistance were in vain.
The owner of the terrifying roar is an intermediate-level monster, the giant saltwater crocodile.
The underground lake at the foot of Thain is its habitat.
At this moment, it stopped roaring and stared at the human. Its huge tail whipped the rock, and its terrifying aura made Thain's hair stand on end as he got a chance to breathe!
The white eyes were glowing in the gray, and most of the head had traces of being burned by fire. It was obvious that Thain's previous magic had also caused some damage to it.
However, in its view, this human being was clearly irritating and provoking itself.
The fear of death has not completely knocked down this black magic apprentice, but the patience of the giant crocodile has been completely exhausted!
It rushed to Thain's side, opened its bloody mouth and bit directly into Thain's head. The sharp fangs were dripping with saliva, and the fishy smell was disgusting.
The fingertips of his right hand used the remaining magic power to release the magic that had been accumulated for a long time——
In an instant, a fireball the size of a football flew out!
The powder instantly caused deflagration, and coupled with the bombardment of the fireball, it exploded instantly!
The deafening explosion shook the entire valley, and the huge front jaw of the giant crocodile was blown to pieces, and blood and flesh were scattered on the ground.
Thain was shaken three to four meters away by the impact. He stood up, looked at the giant crocodile corpse in front of him, and waved his fist excitedly.
The powder, this secondary fireball that Thain had high hopes for, exploded with unimaginable power.
At the end of the battle, due to the excessive consumption of mental power and almost all the magic power, Thain's face became extremely pale at this time.
After regaining a little strength, he first stood up and swam to the small island in the middle of the lake to pick three bright starlight grasses. Then he returned to the battlefield and took away the most precious magic crystal of the saltwater giant crocodile, as well as a giant crocodile skull filled with a lot of elemental power, and then quickly left the lake.
In fact, Thain only took half of the value of the intermediate World of Warcraft Saltwater Crocodile at best.
More corpse materials and the blood of monsters with abundant magical elements were left in place. It was not that he did not want to take them, but that in this underground world, every second was accompanied by danger.
Thain, who has reached the end of his strength, has no fighting power at this time and must not put himself in danger again.
The three starlight grasses were his ultimate goal in venturing into the territory of the giant saltwater crocodile, and the fundamental reason why he risked his life in this leapfrog battle.
"Hoo, hoo." A low breathing sound came from the darkness.
